source_ref: OSF dqw9f (public node; API reports no node licence): Supplemental Studies/Study S2a Data.sav (https://osf.io/download/j7bu9/, sha256 64c2f427...3175ce), S2b (https://osf.io/download/6501ed786d1e89617115155a/, sha256 37cf92d0...ba05dd), S2c (https://osf.io/download/6501f901f3dcd16832ddd406/, sha256 77e72d25...e4732e) -- SPSS variable and value labels of effective1/effective, efficient, organized, goodplace/good_place; data/wallace_2026_mindsets.py for the code derivation. Paper: Wallace, Murphy, Hernandez-Colmenares & Fujita (2026) JPSP 130(2) 291-307, doi:10.1037/pspi0000498.
note: Level 1, both label levels read in the three .sav files that feed this table (sha256 match the batch_647 record / OSF listing). Code derivation (data/wallace_2026_mindsets.py, climate.csv spec): efficient, goodplace (S2a, S2b), effective (S2c) and organized (S2c) ARE the source column names; effective1 -> effective (S2a, S2b) and good_place -> goodplace (S2c) are fixed named renames in the script -- mechanical, so exempt from Step 5b and no verification files. item_text is the SPSS variable label verbatim; the labels are character-identical across every study that carries the item, so no per-study prefixing was needed (efficient's label has no final period in any file; kept as is). organized exists in S2c only. OPTIONS: every item in every study has value labels 1='1 - Strongly agree', 7='7 - Strongly disagree', 2-6 carry only their own digit; the digit prefixes are stripped and 2-6 left blank. NO RECODE for this scale: the script passes all climate columns through unflipped (no itemcov_recoded column in the live table) and all three studies print the same 1 = Strongly agree order. Route 9, all 10 study x item count vectors match source = live exactly, e.g. S2a effective1 52/53/30/23/27/24/5 -> cov_study 5 effective 52/53/30/23/27/24/5; S2b efficient 104/85/53/37/34/24/3 = cov_study 6; S2c good_place 169/173/145/157/63/49/37 -> cov_study 7 goodplace; S2c organized 293/250/94/61/39/44/12 = live. cov_study mapping 5=S2a (214 ids), 6=S2b (340), 7=S2c (793) confirmed from the live counts. Direction cross-check: the growth-mindset condition (Mindset=+1, treat=1) has LOWER item means than fixed (-1) in every study (e.g. goodplace 3.09 vs 3.92 S2a, 2.74 vs 3.69 S2b, 2.64 vs 3.55 S2c), i.e. more agreement that the growth organization is a good place, consistent with 1 = Strongly agree; items intercorrelate +0.56..+0.87. So high resp = LESS agreement, as labelled. No instructions text in any .sav or .sps, and the OSF node holds only data and code folders; instructions left blank. Organization name: the S2a, S2b and S2c labels all say 'The XYZ Organization' (S1a/S1b/S1c labels say MCM; S2a/S2b/S2c have 0 MCM mentions) -- shipped as labelled. Rights: study-authored items, no stated restriction located (silence = permission).
public_note: Responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree in all three studies (a higher value means less agreement); organized was asked in Study S2c (cov_study = 7) only.
